original_unique_solution: Use triangle ABC as tetrahedron base. AB and BC are perpendicular sides of the cuboid bottom rectangle; its area is half of that rectangle. H is above D, so the perpendicular height from H to planeABC equals the box height DH. Therefore V_ABCH=(1/3)*(1/2*AB*BC)*DH=V_box/6. V_ABCH=20 forces V_box=120 for every positive cuboid shape. No perspective ratio is needed.
